_comment: Ghana overlay, applied when Account.countryOfOrigin is GH. Reflects the Value Added Tax Act, 2025 (Act 1151), in force 1 January 2026: 15% VAT + 2.5% NHIL + 2.5% GETFund, all three deductible as input tax and shown on separate invoice lines; the COVID-19 levy and the VAT flat-rate scheme are abolished. Overlay contract: 'remove' drops base numbers (it is an error to remove a number that is not there); 'add' appends accounts (it is an error to reuse a number unless the entry says replace:true).
name: Ghana tax and payroll accounts

taxEntryMap._comment: Keys are TaxEntry.abbreviation values from soupmarkets-web grails-app/conf/seed-data/country/GH/tax-entries.json. liability = number for TaxEntry.liabilityLedgerAccount (output side); recoverable = number for TaxEntry.recoverableLedgerAccount (input side). null = do not link (abolished or sector-specific). optional:true = link only when that number exists in the composed template.
